newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: UEM says not buying Philippines' NSC.
newsitem.headline: UEM says not buying Philippines' NSC.

text.p: United Engineers (Malaysia) Bhd (UEM) denied it was planning to acquire an equity interest in loss-making National Steel Corp (NSC) of the Philippines.

"We wish to inform the Exchange that the company has no intention of acquiring any equity interest in the National Steel Corporation, Philippines," UEM said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
Speculation that the infrastructure construction and road toll operator may be used as a vehicle by its parent, Renong Bhd, to acquire the NSC hit the stock in the last few weeks.
Around 0655 GMT, UEM stock recovered 60 cents to 18.10 ringgit, which analysts said was due to the denial.
Renong stock was down two cents to 3.34 ringgit.
